messages:
jamie_sales: Quick heads-up — Acme POC starts Monday. They need: hosted API keys for devs, a small dedicated pool for load testing, and VPC peering later if things look good.

anika_se: Can we do least-privilege invites? They only need inference + logs, no billing or infra.

devon_infra: Yes. Recommend creating scoped service accounts rather than org invites. Temporary keys + expiry. Example role we can use:

```json
{
  "role": "poc-service",
  "scopes": ["inference:invoke","logs:read"],
  "expires_in": "7d"
}
```

marta_security: Also request SSO + SCIM provisioning if they want >5 seats. For now, for short POC, temp service accounts with rotation are fine. Ensure MFA enforced on user invites.

anika_se: Do we have automated expiration on hosted API keys? sales wants auto-revoke after 14 days unless extended.

devon_infra: provision-bot: created a template for temp keys. We can set TTL on API keys. TTLs currently 7d,14d,30d. Use 14d for this POC. I'll spin up a dedicated pool with 2 GPUs and tag it "poc-acme-3".

provision-bot: provision-bot: Dedicated pool "poc-acme-3" created (2 x A10G), region=us-west-2, tags=[poc,acme].

jamie_sales: Thanks. What about least-priv invites for their engineering and ML team? We want developers to be able to create prompts and run evals but not change pool sizing.

devon_infra: Create roles:
- poc-reader: inference:invoke, embeddings:read, logs:read
- poc-developer: all poc-reader + evals:run, prompts:edit
- poc-admin: full infra:scale, pools:create, billing:read (only for our ops)

marta_security: Add note: no default admin. Sales/account team will request admin with 2 approvers. Log all grant events.

anika_se: Also need pricing note for customer: dedicated pool will be charged to account X, we should create a billing alias and cap for test run.

jamie_sales: I'll send customer the invite links and the service account key. Please confirm TTL and that logs are accessible.

devon_infra: Confirmed. Keys will expire in 14d. Logs accessible via Console under Project > POC > logs. I'll post the console link.

devon_infra: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/poc-acme-3/logs

marta_security: I'll add this POC to our security tracker and add the questionnaire items: data retention, key rotation, and network isolation. Ping me for the SZQ answers.

jamie_sales: Awesome — thanks team. I'll hold off on SSO until they expand past 5 seats.

anika_se: One more: set workspace invite policy to "invite-only" and disable public invite link.

devon_infra: Done. workspace.invite_policy=invite-only

jamie_sales: Perfect. Closing loop.
